scope: Three original-only historical GTA V downloads for PS4 5.05; standalone Load remains unsupported.

actions.label: ArabicGuy
actions.firmwareEvidence: Exact pinned 505/index.html dispatch and PS4 5.05 title; no other firmware, title ID or platform inferred.

loaderEvidence.transport: Host-specific ArrayBuffer copied to code_addr1 + 0x100000, followed by p.fcall(code_addr1). No standalone external loader ABI established.

actions.license: No redistribution licence was established for this compiled menu. Preserve original authorship and host attribution; original upstream download only.
actions.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto V artwork for the ArabicGuy menu family
actions.imageDescription: Existing GTA V artwork reused from this menu family; not a screenshot or hardware verification of the exact build.
requirements: PS4 firmware 5.05 and GTA V game update 1.00; the game update is separate from console firmware.
The matching game build must already run on the console. A menu download does not establish game-boot or backport compatibility.
No regional CUSA list was supplied for this exact build. Confirm the title ID and executable before using it.
The reviewed GamerHack 505 host loads this exact BIN through its in-page native loader. Compatible standalone GoldHEN HTTP or ELF-loader support has not been verified; built-in Load is unavailable.
Use the matching original host or a native loader confirmed compatible with this exact build. Keep one game menu active at a time.
Menu release is not independently established. The source button and file numbers identify the game build; they are not asserted as menu releases.
Download is the original pinned upstream file. No public mirror or redistribution licence is asserted. No payload was executed during review.

versionEvidence.note: Button and file identify the GTA V game update; no independent menu release or regional title IDs supplied.
